title: Amortized Factor Inference Networks for Posterior Inference
abstract: arXiv:2605.26419v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Amortized inference promises fast test-time Bayesian inference, but existing methods typically target a fixed model or a restricted model family. Extending amortization to new model families often requires retraining or test-time fine-tuning. In this paper, we ask: is it possible to build a single inference network capable of generalizing across varying priors, likelihoods, latent dimensions, and observation counts? We introduce Amortized Factor Inference Networks (AFINs), which describe a model as a list of typed prior and likelihood factors and map this description, together with the observations, to a Gaussian posterior approximation through an encode--merge--decode network whose learned parameters do not depend on the latent dimension or the number of observations. Experiments on synthetic and real-data benchmarks show that a single trained AFIN provides competitive posterior approximations at substantially lower test-time cost t

translated_title: 用于后验推断的摊销因子推断网络
translated_abstract: 摊销推断有望实现快速的测试时贝叶斯推断，但现有方法通常针对固定模型或受限的模型族。将摊销推断扩展到新的模型族往往需要重新训练或测试时微调。在本文中，我们提出一个问题：是否有可能构建一个单一的推断网络，使其能够跨不同的先验、似然、潜变量维度和观测数量进行泛化？我们提出了摊销因子推断网络，它将模型描述为一组类型化的先验因子和似然因子，并通过一个编码-合并-解码网络将该描述与观测数据一起映射为高斯后验近似，其学习到的参数不依赖于潜变量维度或观测数量。在合成数据和真实数据基准上的实验表明，单个训练好的AFIN能够以显著更低的测试时成本提供具有竞争力的后验近似。
tldr: 本文提出摊销因子推断网络（AFIN），将模型表示为类型化的先验与似然因子列表，并通过参数不依赖潜变量维度和观测数量的编码-合并-解码网络，实现单一网络跨不同先验、似然、潜变量维度和观测数量的通用后验推断。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Amortized Factor Inference Networks (AFINs), which represent models as lists of typed prior and likelihood factors and map them, together with observations, to a Gaussian posterior approximation via an encode-merge-decode network whose parameters are independent of latent dimension and observation count, enabling a single network to generalize posterior inference across diverse models.
